subject: [PATCH v3] mm/memcontrol: skip non-hierarchical memcg-wide stats when v1 is unavailable

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the Linux kernel's memory control group (memcg) statistics by skipping non-hierarchical memcg-wide stats when the v1 version is unavailable. This is done by compiling out the non-hierarchical arrays if CONFIG_MEMCG_V1 is not set, and skipping updates on these arrays even if v1 is supported but blocked by a boot parameter. The patch aims to reduce flush costs by avoiding unnecessary read-modify-write operations, resulting in a 4.1% reduction in memcg-wide aggregation time and a 2.2% reduction in overall flush function time.
